name: Spotify
author: bityoungjae
description: Spotify-only now-playing bar widget with a garak-style flyout panel

barWidget.description: Spotify icon that lights up while playing; click for album art, seek bar, playback controls, and shuffle / repeat toggles

schema.label: Accent color
schema.description: Color of the bar icon while Spotify is playing. "theme" uses the theme accent, "spotify" uses Spotify green, or pass a #RRGGBB hex.

schema.label: Album art size
schema.description: Album art edge length in unscaled pixels.

schema.label: Panel width
schema.description: Flyout panel width in unscaled pixels.

schema.label: Launch command
schema.description: Command run to start Spotify when it is not running. A running Spotify is focused over MPRIS instead.

schema.label: Hide when Spotify is closed
schema.description: Remove the widget from the bar entirely while Spotify is not running, instead of dimming it.
